skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — create a music video for my song with synced visuals and beat drops — and...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Music Video Maker Free — turn audio files into AI-generated music videos easily.

- Upload MP3, WAV, AAC, or FLAC files (up to 200MB); describe your video; get a synced music video in 1–2 minutes.
- 100 free credits with automatic token generation and backend setup.
- Supports 1080p MP4 output, with options for various formats and aspect ratios.
- Session-based workflow tracks drafts, manages multiple files, and allows iterative editing.
- Automated handling of common workflows, error cases, and account setup for quick onboarding.
